title: An Act to Correct Inconsistencies, Conflicts and Errors in the Laws of Maine (EMERGENCY)

summary.text:
Part A does the following.

Section 1 corrects a reference to the Director of the Governor's Energy Office. Section 2 makes a technical correction.

Section 3 makes a technical correction.

Section 4 corrects gender-specific language and makes grammatical changes.

Section 5 updates outdated language.

Section 6 corrects gender-specific language and makes grammatical changes.

Section 7 corrects a reference to the Department of Administrative and Financial Services and makes a grammatical change.

Section 8 corrects gender-specific language and makes a grammatical change.

Section 9 clarifies an ambiguous term.

Section 10 corrects a headnote.

Section 11 makes a grammatical correction.

Section 12 makes a technical correction.

Section 13 repeals an obsolete definition that is not gender neutral.

Section 14 repeals an obsolete definition that is not gender neutral.

Section 15 corrects gender-specific language.

Section 16 corrects a clerical error.

Section 17 adds a cross-reference to address a gender-specific term and makes technical corrections and grammatical changes.

Section 18 corrects a reference to the Director of the Governor's Energy Office. Section 19 corrects a clerical error.

Section 20 corrects gender-specific language and makes grammatical changes.

Section 21 corrects gender-specific language and makes grammatical changes.

Section 22 corrects gender-specific language and makes grammatical changes.

Section 23 corrects gender-specific language and makes grammatical changes.

Sections 24 and 25 correct the allocation of a subsection enacted in Public Law 2023, chapter 669.

Sections 26 and 27 correct a cross-reference.

Sections 28 and 29 make a technical correction.

Section 30 corrects a conflict created by Public Law 2023, chapters 583 and 646, which affected the same provision of law, by repealing the provision and replacing it with the chapter 583 version.

Section 31 makes a technical correction.

Section 32 corrects a cross-reference.

Sections 33 to 35 repeal an obsolete provision.

Section 36 corrects a cross-reference.

Section 37 makes a technical correction.

Sections 38 to 48 correct a conflict created by Public Law 2023, chapters 241 and 309, which affected the same provisions of law, by incorporating the changes made by both laws.

Section 49 repeals an obsolete chapter.

Section 50 corrects a reference to the Children's Health Insurance Program.

Section 51 corrects a conflict created by Public Law 2023, chapters 646 and 679, which affected the same provision of law, by repealing the provision and replacing it with the chapter 679 version.

Section 52 corrects a cross-reference.

Section 53 corrects a conflict created by Public Law 2023, chapters 67 and 676, which affected the same provision of law, by repealing the provision.

Section 54 makes technical corrections.

Section 55 corrects a reference to the United States Department of Transportation, Federal Railroad Administration.

Sections 56 and 57 remove an obsolete cross-reference.

Section 58 corrects gender-specific language and makes a technical correction. Section 59 makes a technical correction.

Section 60 makes technical corrections.

Section 61 makes technical corrections.

Section 62 makes technical corrections.

Section 63 corrects a cross-reference.

Section 64 corrects a reference.

Section 65 corrects a reference.

Section 66 corrects a reference.

Section 67 removes an obsolete cross-reference.

Section 68 corrects a conflict created by Public Law 2023, chapters 641 and 679, which affected the same provision of law, by repealing the provision and replacing it with the chapter 679 version.

Section 69 corrects a clerical error.

Section 70 corrects cross-references.

Section 71 makes a technical correction.

Section 72 removes an obsolete reference, corrects gender-specific language and makes grammatical changes.

Sections 73 and 74 correct a numbering problem created by Public Law 2023, chapters 643 and 675, which enacted 3 substantively different provisions with the same section number.

Section 75 makes a technical correction.

Section 76 makes a grammatical change and a technical correction.

Section 77 corrects a conflict created by Public Law 2023, chapters 644 and 660, which enacted 2 substantively different provisions with the same subsection number, by repealing the provision and replacing it with the chapter 660 version.

Sections 78 and 79 make technical corrections.

Sections 80 and 81 correct the allocation of a subsection enacted in Public Law 2023, chapter 669.
